caption: A later reconstruction drawing of the first Fort Dearborn and its stockade at the river mouth.
note: Commons; year is the scene depicted (the drawing is a 19th-century reconstruction, creation date not seen).

caption: The last buildings of the second Fort Dearborn, photographed in 1856 amid the growing city.
Rufus Blanchard's hand-colored view of old Fort Dearborn and its surroundings as they stood in 1856.
note: LOC; lithograph published by Rufus Blanchard, Chicago, 1894, depicting 1856.

caption: The bronze Fort Dearborn tablet on the London Guarantee Building, marking the fort's site.
note: LOC Keystone View Co. stereograph, ca. 1930.

caption: The Fort Dearborn massacre monument that stood near the 1812 battle site on the South Side.
note: LOC Keystone View Co. stereograph, ca. 1930. The statue is at the Prairie Ave battle site, not the fort itself.

caption: Henry Hering's 1928 'Defense' relief on the Michigan Avenue bridge, showing the 1812 battle.
Markers in the sidewalk at Michigan and Wacker trace the outline of the old fort.
